prompt: Create an antique illuminated-manuscript style illustration of a vast medieval scriptorium hall filled with monks copying books. The image should look like a weathered parchment print with sepia, ochre, dark brown, faded blue ink accents, visible crosshatching, stippled engraving texture, foxing stains, and an aged paper border. Show a long vaulted rectangular hall in deep one-point perspective, with a high arched timber ceiling, tall narrow windows lining both left and right walls, and a central aisle receding to a small doorway at the far end. Include exactly 53 visible monks in brown robes seated at individual wooden desks arranged in orderly rows on both sides of the aisle; each monk is bent over an open manuscript, writing with a quill. Place open books on every desk with dense blue calligraphic lines, plus small black inkpots and writing tools on many desktops. The nearest foreground desks should be larger and more detailed, with three prominent monks at the front left, front center, and front right, while the remaining monks diminish toward the vanishing point. Use a solemn scholarly atmosphere, no modern objects, no readable modern text, no captions, no watermark, and keep the composition framed like an old historical etching on parchment.
